let Keyed = system(
  var p in {idle, got, crit}
  var q in {idle, got, crit}
  var lp in 0..2
  var lq in 0..2
  var tab in 0..2
  init p = idle ∧ q = idle ∧ lp = 0 ∧ lq = 0 ∧ tab = 0
  action pget when p = idle ∧ tab ≠ 0 do lp := tab, p := got
  action pnew when p = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lq ≠ 1 do tab := 1, lp := 1, p := got
  action pnew2 when p = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lq = 1 do tab := 2, lp := 2, p := got
  action pwait when p = got ∧ ¬(q = crit ∧ lq = lp) do p := crit
  action pdone when p = crit do tab := 0, lp := 0, p := idle
  action qget when q = idle ∧ tab ≠ 0 do lq := tab, q := got
  action qnew when q = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lp ≠ 1 do tab := 1, lq := 1, q := got
  action qnew2 when q = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lp = 1 do tab := 2, lq := 2, q := got
  action qwait when q = got ∧ ¬(p = crit ∧ lp = lq) do q := crit
  action qdone when q = crit do tab := 0, lq := 0, q := idle
)
column3: = system({p, q, lp, lq, tab}, {pget, pnew, pnew2, pwait, pdone, qget, qnew, qnew2, qwait, qdone})   [32 reachable states]

column2: trace(Keyed; pnew, qget, pwait, pdone, qwait, qdone)
column3: = p = idle ∧ q = idle ∧ lp = 0 ∧ lq = 0 ∧ tab = 0

column2: invariant(Keyed, (p = crit → lp = tab) ∧ (q = crit → lq = tab))

let Checked = system(
  var p in {idle, got, took, crit, out}
  var q in {idle, got, took, crit, out}
  var lp in 0..2
  var lq in 0..2
  var tab in 0..2
  init p = idle ∧ q = idle ∧ lp = 0 ∧ lq = 0 ∧ tab = 0
  action pget when p = idle ∧ tab ≠ 0 do lp := tab, p := got
  action pnew when p = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lq ≠ 1 do tab := 1, lp := 1, p := got
  action pnew2 when p = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lq = 1 do tab := 2, lp := 2, p := got
  action pwait when p = got ∧ ¬((q = took ∨ q = crit ∨ q = out) ∧ lq = lp) do p := took
  action pok when p = took ∧ tab = lp do p := crit
  action pretry when p = took ∧ tab ≠ lp do lp := 0, p := idle
  action premove when p = crit do tab := 0, p := out
  action prelease when p = out do lp := 0, p := idle
  action qget when q = idle ∧ tab ≠ 0 do lq := tab, q := got
  action qnew when q = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lp ≠ 1 do tab := 1, lq := 1, q := got
  action qnew2 when q = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lp = 1 do tab := 2, lq := 2, q := got
  action qwait when q = got ∧ ¬((p = took ∨ p = crit ∨ p = out) ∧ lp = lq) do q := took
  action qok when q = took ∧ tab = lq do q := crit
  action qretry when q = took ∧ tab ≠ lq do lq := 0, q := idle
  action qremove when q = crit do tab := 0, q := out
  action qrelease when q = out do lq := 0, q := idle
)
column3: = system({p, q, lp, lq, tab}, {pget, pnew, pnew2, pwait, pok, pretry, premove, prelease, qget, qnew, qnew2, qwait, qok, qretry, qremove, qrelease})   [85 reachable states]

column2: inductive(Checked, (p = crit → lp = tab) ∧ (q = crit → lq = tab) ∧ ¬(p = crit ∧ q = crit))

inductive(Checked, (p = crit → lp = tab) ∧ (q = crit → lq = tab) ∧ ¬((p = took ∨ p = crit ∨ p = out) ∧ (q = took ∨ q = crit ∨ q = out) ∧ lp = lq) ∧ (p = idle → lp = 0) ∧ (q = idle → lq = 0) ∧ (p ≠ idle → lp ≠ 0) ∧ (q ≠ idle → lq ≠ 0))

let Counted = system(
  var p in {idle, got, crit}
  var q in {idle, got, crit}
  var lp in 0..2
  var lq in 0..2
  var tab in 0..2
  var n in 0..2
  init p = idle ∧ q = idle ∧ lp = 0 ∧ lq = 0 ∧ tab = 0 ∧ n = 0
  action pget when p = idle ∧ tab ≠ 0 do lp := tab, n := n + 1, p := got
  action pnew when p = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lq ≠ 1 do tab := 1, lp := 1, n := 1, p := got
  action pnew2 when p = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lq = 1 do tab := 2, lp := 2, n := 1, p := got
  action pwait when p = got ∧ ¬(q = crit ∧ lq = lp) do p := crit
  action pleave when p = crit ∧ n > 1 do n := n - 1, lp := 0, p := idle
  action plast when p = crit ∧ n = 1 do n := 0, tab := 0, lp := 0, p := idle
  action qget when q = idle ∧ tab ≠ 0 do lq := tab, n := n + 1, q := got
  action qnew when q = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lp ≠ 1 do tab := 1, lq := 1, n := 1, q := got
  action qnew2 when q = idle ∧ tab = 0 ∧ lp = 1 do tab := 2, lq := 2, n := 1, q := got
  action qwait when q = got ∧ ¬(p = crit ∧ lp = lq) do q := crit
  action qleave when q = crit ∧ n > 1 do n := n - 1, lq := 0, q := idle
  action qlast when q = crit ∧ n = 1 do n := 0, tab := 0, lq := 0, q := idle
)
column3: = system({p, q, lp, lq, tab, n}, {pget, pnew, pnew2, pwait, pleave, plast, qget, qnew, qnew2, qwait, qleave, qlast})   [8 reachable states]
